events.description: 26. Minute Entry for proceedings held before Judge Steve C. Jones: Motion Hearing held on 9/12/2024 re [18] MOTION to Intervene. Hearing held on relief sought within Plaintiff's Complaint pursuant to the Court's [6] Order of 8/30/2024. The Court first heard argument on the motion to intervene as Defendant by New Georgia Project [18]. Verbal Order: motion to intervene GRANTED. The Court directed Plaintiffs to file an Amended Complaint on or before 8/16/2024, with Defendants to respond within seven days thereafter. The Court will reconvene this hearing on a later date, to be determined. (Court Reporter Penny Coudriet)(rsg)

events.description: 28. ORDER granting the New Georgia Project Action Fund's Motion to Intervene. Doc. No. [18]. Because the Court permits this intervention pursuant to Rule 24(b ), it need not determine whether NGP AF could intervene as of right under Rule 24(a). The Court DIRECTS the Clerk to add New Georgia Project Action Fund as an Intervenor Defendant in this action. NGPAF also requested the Court allow it to file a motion to dismiss. Doc. No. [18], 2; see also Doc. No. [18-3] (proposed motion to dismiss). At the hearing, the Court granted NGP AF' s request to file a motion to dismiss and established a 7-day briefing schedule on this motion. Thus, the Court DIRECTS the Clerk to enter the proposed motion to dismiss found at Doc. No. [18-3] on the docket. The Court acknowledges, however, that, upon the filing of the anticipated amended complaint, the motion to dismiss and the briefing schedule will become moot. See Doc. No. [27], 2 & n.2 (setting the deadlines for the amended complaint and subsequent responses). Signed by Judge Steve C. Jones on 9/12/2024. (rsg)
